svg.text: ESML · DMML + Context Map · Intent Registry
Deterministic gate checks (non-AI) — every stage must pass before the next can run
Every rule names its enforcement point
Every rule and action names its test evidence
Open gaps must be flagged as blocking
Gates prove structure, traceability and coverage — not business correctness. That is established by human approval (step 5).
1 Specific validation errors are fed back to the LLM
2 Bounded number of repair attempts — each one logged
3 Still failing → errors and output surfaced to a human
